services.desc: Come aboard our Cape Cod Sunset Cruise! Duration 1.5 hours About Experience the magic of Cape Cod's sunset aboard the White Shark for an unforgettable evening with your loved ones. Designed for couples, groups of friends, or the whole family, our Cape Cod sunset cruise offers a breathtaking journey through Saquatucket and Wychmere harbors against the backdrop of Nantucket Sound. Imagine the serene beauty of a Cape Cod sunset, as the sun dips below the horizon, painting the sky in vibrant hues of orange, pink, and gold.
